avertissements.straightRow: Straight rows of keys are easy to guess.
avertissements.keyPattern: Short keyboard patterns are easy to guess.
avertissements.simpleRepeat: Repeated characters like “aaa” are easy to guess.
avertissements.extendedRepeat: Repeated patterns like “abcabcabc” are easy to guess.
avertissements.sequences: Sequences like “abc” or “1234” are easy to guess.
avertissements.recentYears: Recent years are easy to guess.
avertissements.topTen: This is one of the most used passwords in the world.
avertissements.topHundred: This password is used very often.
avertissements.common: This is a commonly used password.
avertissements.similarToCommon: This looks like a commonly used password.
avertissements.wordByItself: A single word is easy to guess.
avertissements.namesByThemselves: A single name or surname is easy to guess.
avertissements.commonNames: Common names and surnames are easy to guess.
avertissements.userInputs: Avoid your name, your email, your company or the site name.
avertissements.pwned: This password has already leaked in a data breach.

suggestions.allUppercase: Capitalize some letters, not all of them.
suggestions.capitalization: A capital letter somewhere other than the start helps a little.
suggestions.dates: Avoid dates and years associated with you.
suggestions.associatedYears: Avoid years associated with you (birth, etc.).
suggestions.longerKeyboardPattern: Use longer keyboard patterns and change direction.
suggestions.anotherWord: Add one or two unexpected words.
suggestions.useWords: Use several words, but not a well-known phrase.
suggestions.noNeed: No need for symbols or numbers: a few unexpected words are enough.
suggestions.pwned: If you use it elsewhere, change it.
